subject: Spontaneous application — Data Engineering Internship at Clarins
body:
Dear Hiring Manager,

Please find attached my CV and cover letter for a Data Engineering internship at Clarins. I am a Master’s student in computer science with experience in Python and SQL, and I am motivated by your interest in data analytics.

I would be pleased to discuss how I can contribute. Thank you for your consideration.

Kind regards,
John Doe
john@example.com
+33 6 00 00 00 00

letter.name: John Doe
letter.subject: Spontaneous application – Data Engineering Internship
body: I am writing to express my interest in a Data Engineering internship at Clarins. Your activity in the cosmetics sector and your interest in data analytics align with my academic focus and my motivation to contribute to data‑driven initiatives.

Currently enrolled in a Master en informatique (2024–2026) at Université Exemple, I recently completed a development internship at Entreprise Exemple (2025) where I developed Python scripts and wrote SQL queries. These experiences, combined with my skills in Python, SQL and Linux, have strengthened my ability to process data and support analytics work.
I would welcome the opportunity to discuss how I could contribute to your projects. Thank you for considering my application.

cv.name: John Doe
cv.headline: Étudiant en informatique — Stage en Data Engineering
cv.summary: Étudiant intéressé par l'ingénierie des données, maîtrisant Python, SQL et Linux, à la recherche d'un stage en Data Engineering, idéalement dans le secteur des cosmétiques.

achievements: Développement de scripts en Python pour automatiser des traitements
Rédaction de requêtes SQL pour l'extraction et l'analyse de données
